title: Addressing the Second Component
statement: For any bit strings $x,b,\mathrm{tail}$ and any natural number $j<|b|$, the bit at position $4|x|+4+2j$ in the encoding of the encoding of $x$ paired with $b$, then paired with $\mathrm{tail}$, is the bit of $b$ at position $j$.
